card.capacity_status_quote: Indium phosphide has been the key constraint for us for a number of quarters—it is a constraint for the industry.
card.demand_direction_quote: Growth in this segment accelerated again this quarter with revenue increasing more than 40% year over year.
card.pricing_power_quote: On pricing, dynamics are very healthy given supply versus demand. One thing that happens as we change data rates is ASPs go up—1.6T pricing is higher than 800G, etc.
card.guidance_direction_quote: We expect strong sequential revenue growth in our June quarter, and we continue to expect fiscal 2027 growth to exceed our fiscal 2026 growth rate.
card.constraint_owner_quote: Customer demand remains exceptionally strong with no signs of attenuation, and our visibility continues to extend further into the future with orders now reaching into calendar 2028
